design_and_inference_limits: Three dependency-linked metadata groups; PI OpenPI transport is nested, not a fourth independent checkpoint.
Recipes and metadata were inspected before selected native execution; outcome-unseen does not mean blinded or unseen root causes.
Queries, seeds, interventions, shared ancestry and clean repeats are not independent samples. No population accuracy, confidence interval or significance conclusion is supported.
Large declared normalization changes test evidence distinctions; no sensitivity estimate for subtle natural drift.
References are current-runtime numerical contracts; training-runtime identity, model-output reachability and calibrated physical meaning are not established.
Empirical numerical allowances are fixed profiles, not universal upstream floating-point or sensor-error bounds.
Historical, stateful and Panda software strata remain retrospective/development evidence, with no physics stepping, learned-policy task performance or hardware-safety claim.
Current task reanalyses prior saved acquisitions. Earlier clean native reproduction is traceable prior evidence on the same machine with permitted cache reuse.
No reduction in human integration effort was measured; measured call-count witnesses favor the independent numerical oracles.
Producer hashes/audit hooks are not cryptographic attestation or an operating-system sandbox.
literature_scope: Focused primary-source checks of the cited closest work and established testing precedents; not an exhaustive systematic review or proof of novelty.
